entities.name: Leonard O'Brien

entities.summary: Leonard Francis "Mike" O'Brien was an American field hockey player who won the team bronze in the 1932 Summer Olympics, and was a player-manager during the 1936 Summer Olympics. He went on to become an investment broker in Boston.
